owner.name: Rowan Stratton
owner.summary: Research Software Engineer specializing in human-centered interactive systems and serious games for stress resilience. I design and execute mixed-method research (quantitative surveys, qualitative focus groups, research probes) and translate findings into scalable full-stack systems. Architect of a large-scale narrative behavioral platform. Published four peer-reviewed HCI papers exploring emotional modeling, dynamic difficulty adjustment, and playful stress intervention design.

faq.q: What kind of roles are you looking for?
faq.a: Research Engineer, Software Engineer (HCI/gameful systems), or full-stack roles with strong product + human-centered focus. I'm particularly interested in positions combining rigorous research methodology with shipping real systems.

faq.q: What's your approach to research and development?
faq.a: I follow a research-to-build pipeline: start with mixed-methods research (surveys, focus groups, user studies), translate findings into clear system requirements, then deliver scalable full-stack implementations. I believe technology should be grounded in understanding real user needs.

Four peer-reviewed HCI papers on serious games, narrative design, and emotional modeling. Topics include dynamic difficulty adjustment for emotional pacing, play-oriented gamification for college student stress, narrative scaffolds for reflection, and robotic voice modulation based on emotional arousal.

faq.q: What's your experience with team leadership?
faq.a: I've led a 3-person undergraduate team as technical lead on a research project, managing scoping, task assignment, weekly check-ins, code review, and team unblocking. I also mentor individual researchers on study design and synthesis.

Full-stack development with emphasis on research-driven systems. Backend: Django/DRF, Node.js, microservices, databases. Frontend: React, React Native, modern CSS. DevOps: Docker, CI/CD, cloud deployment. I'm strongest when bridging research questions and robust technical implementation.

faq.q: What's your stance on technology and well-being?
faq.a: I'm cautious about tech that prioritizes engagement metrics over actual user well-being. My work focuses on designing systems that support real outcomes like flourishing, stress resilience, and meaningful reflection—not just retention or usage time.
